releaseNotes:
- Android: Live stream frame decodes immediately promote connection state to STREAMING, eliminating stuck "Reconnecting to Windows host..." banners
- Android: Automatic session token fallback across input handlers ensures mouse and touch coordinates are never dropped due to transient stream reconnects
- Android: Dynamic desktop aspect ratio mapping prevents letterbox margin mis-clicks in Fit display mode
- Android: Replaced missing Unicode glyph box with crisp hardware-accelerated vector power icon
- Windows & Host: Added automatic ControlKeyboard permission grant on mouse authorization and instantaneous auto-dismissal of Pairing & Verification modal
- Security: Full APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 key rotation lineage preserved for smooth seamless in-place updates
releaseHighlights: Android: Instant reconnect recovery — active video frame decodes clear reconnect banner immediately
Android: Host pairing modal auto-dismisses immediately upon PIN approval
Android: Full touch, mouse, and keyboard input integration with persistent session authorization
Android: Dynamic aspect ratio touch mapping for accurate desktop coordinate scaling
Android: Native vector power icon replaces system font tofu glyphs
Android: APK Signature Scheme v3/v3.1 rotation lineage for seamless upgrade
